value.description:
Annelitrice Undead are bound by a curse that denies them a proper death. Their bodies are frail, easily broken but strangely difficult to destroy completely. Even when slain, their flesh collapses into Ashes, yet Humanity lingers within the remains.

The curse does not remain with its bearer alone. An Annelitrice Undead may imprint the Darksign on another humanoid, causing Humanity to gather within the victim until Ashes carrying fragments of memory are shed. From these remnants emerge small, wandering phantoms of Humanity. Fed on Souls, these fragments of Humanity gradually take form and awaken once more in human shape.

They tend to gather in strange, insular groups. With much of their former lives lost to the curse, these communities are often built around half-remembered stories, faded identities, or whatever books, relics, and fragments of the past happen to remain in their possession.

Use an Annelitrice Soul to kindle Ashes or restore a fallen Annelitrice Undead to life. A Bonfire can automate both rites.
